A CD register should not become another admin job.

That is what matters about Titan CD Register.

It is not a separate bolt-on sitting outside the workflow. It is built into the same process the team is already using when a controlled drug is handed out.

Sukhi has been using it in the pharmacy, and the difference was immediate.

“It’s saved me so much time already.”

The workflow is simple enough that his locums were using it within 5 to 10 minutes.

And because it sits inside Titan, the details move with the process.

✅ Barcode scanning pulls through the batch number and expiry date
✅ eDoH on handout captures the patient details
✅ The information goes straight into Titan CD Register
✅ The CD balance stays more accurate
✅ The team avoids entering the same information twice

That is the real time saving.

Not asking the team to learn another system.

Not adding another admin layer.

Not moving the same information from one place to another.

Just removing steps from a job every pharmacy has to get right.

When Sukhi was asked what he would say to any pharmacy that has not downloaded Titan CD Register yet, his answer was simple:

“Why haven’t you?”

His point was clear.

Every pharmacy is trying to find more time in the day.

More time for services.
More time for clinical checks.
More time to work on the business.
More time away from simply getting prescriptions checked and cleared.

That is where Titan CD Register fits.

Not as another thing to manage.

As part of the workflow that gives time back.
